name: Pulse Music v4.2.2 - Pixel Expressive Motion, Wavy Ring Player, Spotify Home & JioSaavn Endless Language Radio
body:
# Pulse Music v4.2.2 - Pixel Expressive Motion, Wavy Ring Player, Spotify Home & JioSaavn Endless Language Radio

Official multi-platform release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, **Obtainium**, and **Web**.

---

### 🎨 Vibrant Expressive Circular Player Overhaul
- **Material 3 Expressive Wavy Circular Progress Ring**: Interactive undulating sine-wave arc around the circular album artwork while playing, smoothly settling flat when paused or scrubbing, with glowing scrub thumb and micro-haptics.
- **Stationary Clean Layout**: Removed horizontal marquee, slide transitions, horizontal album carousel scroll, rotating vinyl animation, and the duplicate lower progress bar; centered the audio quality badge cleanly beneath the album art.

### 📱 Google Pixel Expressive Motion & Scrolling Physics
- **Tactile Springs & Haptics**: Pixel spatial spring transitions (`PixelMotion`), press scale-down, hover lift, shape morphing, and micro-haptics across navigation bars, mini-player, buttons, cards, and chips.
- **Pixel Scroll Physics**: Vertical overscroll stretch (`pixelVerticalOverscroll`) and item scale/alpha kinematics (`pixelScrollScale`, `pixelGridScrollScale`) across Home, Search, Library, Playlist Grid, and Settings.

### 🔁 Same-Language Endless Queue
- **Continuous Regional Radio**: Playing any search or library track seamlessly extends endless same-language radio queues with expanded regional Indic language filtering and duplicate prevention without cross-language leakage.

### 🟢 Spotify Home Feeds & Explicit Account Controls
- **Playlists, Trending Songs & History**: Fixed Spotify token acquisition (TOTP, transport & web session fallbacks), nullable JSON deserialization, Trending Songs charts, Listening History fallbacks (`/recently-played` -> `/me/top/tracks` -> `/me/tracks`), and standalone Home rendering.
- **Clear Account Controls**: Explicit **YouTube Login / YouTube Logout** and **Spotify Login / Spotify Logout** entries in Settings, dialogs, and login screens.
changelog: Vibrant Expressive Player: Material 3 Expressive wavy circular progress ring around stationary album art, no track-change marquee/slide, no disc rotation, and removed bottom progress bar
Google Pixel Expressive Motion & Scroll Physics: Tactile springs, tap scale, hover lift, haptics, vertical overscroll stretch, and list/grid scroll kinematics
Same-Language Endless Queue: Continuous multi-page regional language radio without cross-language artist leakage or stalling
Spotify Home & Account Controls: Fixed user playlists, trending songs charts, listening history fallbacks, and explicit YouTube / Spotify Login and Logout controls
